test_title: PYST 32: SSC MTS - English (Held on: 5 Oct 2021 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution required’.**

We watched the workman __to be removing__ the damaged tiles.
solution: The correct answer is '**remove**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The given sentence is **grammatically incorrect**. • Here,** 'remove'** should be used instead of** 'to be removing'.** • When an **infinitive** is used without the marker '**to**' it is called **a bare infinitive.** • The **infinitive** is used without to after certain verbs like **bid, let, make, see, hear, remove, need, dare, etc**. • Example: *I **bade** him go. *(**NOT** I bade him to go.) **Correct Sentence:__** *We watched the workman **remove** the damaged tiles.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__** • दिया गया वाक्य व्याकरण की दृष्टि से गलत है। • यहां **'to be removing'** के स्थान पर** 'remove' **का प्रयोग करना चाहिए। • जब बिना '**to**' के एक **infinitive** का प्रयोग किया जाता है तो इसे **bare infinitive **कहा जाता है। • इनफिनिटिव का **'to'** के बिना उपयोग कुछ क्रियाओं जैसे **bid, let, make, see hear, remove, need, dare, etc.** आदि के साथ किया जाता है। • Example: *I bade him go. *(NOT I bade him to go.) 41:T514, The correct answer is** 'Sell very fast'.**
